title: SLIDE: a surrogate fairness constraint to ensure fairness consistency
benchmark_measurement: The paper does not measure anything related to faith or religion. The benchmarks measure fairness based on sensitive attributes like gender, age, and race in classification tasks.
models_tested: single hidden layer deep neural networks
findings: The paper does not contain any findings related to religion.
